snippet.title: Moussacre - Iron Woods + DEMO 4 Trailer (Mickey Mouse/Steamboat Willie Public Domain Game)
snippet.description:
New DEMO 4 is now available! Play Moussacre on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668740/Moussacre/
Support Moussacre on KICKSTARTER: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nickdonnoligames/moussacre

Join the DISCORD server and keep up with game development: https://discord.com/invite/hmfdXs6hQK

Moussacre is a fast-paced 2D platformer inspired by classic cartoons; each animation being carefully drawn frame by frame. Run through levels at blistering speeds while slashing apart all who stand in your way.

This isn't your normal, family-friendly cartoon mouse. Meet MouseTrap, the paint-thirsty killing machine who yearns to steal victims' color. Prison was not nice to this poor soul. After being forced to star in cartoons for nearly a century, he completely overhauls his identity to break away from who he once was, eventually adopting his prison name, "MouseTrap." This all leads to him executing his grand prison escape, finally being free from the clutches of his owners. Still dead set on filling his life with color, MouseTrap heads for the Prisma Fortress, a massive tower said to hold the ultimate source of color; the Prisma Diamond.

Welcome to the public domain, Mickey Mouse!

WEBSITE: https://www.nickdonnoligames.com/games-moussacre
YOUTUBE: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtXkDzzbz_26gbzmuRVLOiw

#moussacre #mickeymouse #steamboatwillie
